name: CBRS Wafer-Scale AI Inference Valuation
rationale: Cerebras Systems Inc. (CBRS) produces the monolithic Wafer-Scale Engine (WSE-3), bypassing traditional board-level GPU communication limits with 21 PB/s memory bandwidth and 2,500+ tok/s throughput. TTM revenue reached $510.0M (+74.3% YoY). At $177.25, our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $237.56 (+34.0% upside at 11.91% WACC). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in a 53.8% CAGR, below our 55.0% base case. Recommendation: ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 4.5 shares, 2.74% target weight). Accumulate on dips near $159.96, trim Tier 1 at $237.56.

bear.rationale: High customer concentration in G42/Middle East slows diversification; warrant dilution from OpenAI/AWS contracts limits per-share equity value.
risks: Delays in sovereign AI cloud deployments in non-US jurisdictions
Post-IPO lockup expiry selling pressure and warrant dilution

base.rationale: Wafer-Scale Engine (WSE-3) captures massive inference market share across AWS Bedrock and OpenAI ($20B backlog); 21 PB/s memory bandwidth moat commands premium multiples.
risks: TSMC monolithic wafer packaging capacity allocation bottlenecks
Enterprise switching costs to proprietary Cerebras software compiler

bull.rationale: Cerebras becomes universal hardware benchmark for frontier reasoning & agentic swarm inference; multi-gigawatt sovereign AI supercomputer contracts scale globally.
risks: Next-generation optical interconnect GPU architectures narrowing latency advantage
US export control restrictions on high-throughput AI wafer engines
